question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS root_id,
        id AS current_id,
        0 AS depth,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS multiplier
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.multiplier * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(multiplier) AS total_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE current_id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations))
    GROUP BY root_id
) AS totals
